name: CHAMS HOLDING COMPANY PLC
source: H1 2026 (period ended 30th June 2026, unaudited) added from Chams Holding Company Plc unaudited consolidated and separate financial statements 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib); N'000 x1000. Group column. EPS left blank: the filing's EPS row could not be aligned to the 6-month Group column. | CHAMS Holding Company Plc audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, Group Financial Summary page 77, printed in thousands of naira; values stored below as absolute naira. Rows the audited summary does not print (Cost of Sales, Gross Profit, Operating Expenses, EBIT, Net Finance Costs) are left absent rather than carried over from the previous misaligned columns. | CRON 20261005: added Operating Expenses, Operating Profit (EBIT) and Net Finance Costs from the audited consolidated statement of profit or loss, page 13 of the FY2025 annual report (Group column, N thousands, stored as absolute naira). Operating Expenses is the sum of the printed selling and marketing, employees and other related, depreciation and amortisation, and administrative expense lines. Net Finance Costs is the printed interest expense less the printed interest income. Ties: 3,759,704 gross profit plus 439,196 other operating income less 2,828,251 operating expenses equals 1,370,649 operating profit; 1,370,649 less 563,885 equals 806,764 profit before tax; 806,764 less 389,671 income tax equals 417,093 profit for the year, and FY2024 ties at every step. The stored Revenue row holds the printed Gross earnings figure, so no Cost of Sales or Gross Profit row is stored and the Revenue less Cost of Sales identity is deliberately not asserted for this issuer.
